hooks.name: Worker: ruff + mypy on save
hooks.description: Runs ruff and mypy whenever a .py file is saved. No-ops until the Python worker package exists.

action.command: if [ -f worker/pyproject.toml ]; then cd worker && ruff check . && mypy .; else echo "pigeonhole: worker not set up yet (needs Python>=3.11) — skipping"; fi
